variance_model.identity: Var_HWCS = (1-alpha)*Var_nativeG4 + alpha*Var_G16, alpha = r*(1-q)/(1-p)  [CORRECTED: was 1-p*q*r=1-p^2; numerical alpha always used 1-p, MC-verified]
variance_model.ordering_caveat: G4<=HWCS<=G16 holds ONLY when within-parent signed cross-terms are non-negative (s2>=s1); scene-dependent, NOT universal. The convex-blend identity IS universal. Independently confirmed: signed test gave s2-s1=-23.8 (negative).
variance_model.kappa_status: cost-model operation-efficiency parameter; NOT identifiable from intersection counts; Stage B-min reports structural ENTRY COUNTS only, not kappa

work_saving_vs_nativeG4_p25._conditioning: N1 + assumed structural cost model only; intersection-count proxy, NOT GPU time; fails for N2 mask-then-bin

g4_work_floor_undercut._conditioning: N1 + cost model only; kappa* is a cost-model break-even, NOT a measurable threshold; fails for N2

verdict_rationale: Math sound (MC-validated <0.3%); HWCS-1 undercuts the Native-G4 N1 dense-binning work floor in 9/9 states UNDER THE ASSUMED STRUCTURAL COST MODEL (not N2, not GPU time); but ALL quality/cost numbers are proxy or predicted, never measured; decisive unknowns (real HWCS NMSE, child-refine entry COUNTS, GPU-time realization, N1-vs-N2 baseline) require Stage B-min measurement before any Codex/CUDA authorization. No count-based kappa threshold is a CUDA GO gate.
work_model_N1_conditioning: The work-floor undercut (HWCS-1 below Native-G4 dense-binning floor) and break-even kappa* are CONDITIONAL on (a) the assumed cost model and (b) Native-G4 using the N1 dense-bin-then-mask baseline. kappa is an operation-cost-efficiency parameter and CANNOT be identified from geometric tile counts; it requires Stage C CUDA timing. If Native-G4 uses N2 (mask-then-bin), HWCS has no structural edge.
